title.zh: 将北三宝颜省 Leon B. Postigo 市镇 Tinuyop 描笼涯的 Bacungan 国立中学的 Tinuyop 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Bacungan National High School – Tinuyop Annex in Barangay Tinuyop, Municipality of Leon B. Postigo, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte From the Bacungan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Tinuyop National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tinuyop của Trường Trung học Bacungan Quốc gia tại Barangay Tinuyop, Đô thị Leon B. Postigo, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Norte khỏi Trường Trung học Bacungan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tinuyop Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tinuyop ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bacungan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Tinuyop เทศบาล Leon B. Postigo จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Norte ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bacungan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tinuyop แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tinuyop, Sekolah Menengah Bacungan Nasional di Barangay Tinuyop, Kotamadya Leon B. Postigo, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Norte dari Sekolah Menengah Bacungan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tinuyop Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Tinuyop, Sekolah Menengah Bacungan Kebangsaan di Barangay Tinuyop, Perbandaran Leon B. Postigo, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Norte daripada Sekolah Menengah Bacungan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tinuyop Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Bacungan National High School – Tinuyop Annex in Barangay Tinuyop, Municipality of Leon B. Postigo, Province of Zamboanga del Norte is hereby separated from the Bacungan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Tinuyop National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Bacungan National High School – Tinuyop Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tinuyop National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tinuyop National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Bacungan National High School – Tinuyop Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
